construct.constructDefinition: 课后回顾；EMU单课v6.0的原内容块，原题号23,24,25,26,27。作者有意不形成维度量表或总分；未来在许可明确后走原生无计分Form，不能称实际教学质量得分。

administration.timeFrame: 单节具体课堂，非长期累计判断；当前仅目录候选，不能施测。
layoutConstraints: 保留原角色、原题号、德文、性别措辞及DU/SIE指导语。
原核心块是四档同意程度响应；本候选不提供选项原文或评分。
五分钟只是本项目目录估计，不是原件独立子块施测时长。
拆分、数字嵌入及翻译的具体授权未建立；不把单课v6.0与40项长期版混合。

intendedUses.notes: 原用途为教师教育/学校实践中的诊断与自我反思；当前候选未获平台使用批准。官方不将原工具定位为科研。

localization.translationSource: A. Helmke et al., EMU core v6.0, original German metadata only. No item text translation/transcription distributed.
localization.notes: Chinese editorial names and original commentary do not constitute a translated EMU questionnaire.

limitations: No executable questionnaire or score report. Original authors intentionally use individual-item feedback, not domain scales or totals.
Educational/noncommercial eligibility and adaptation/digital embedding/redistribution consent are unresolved; no rights approved.
Student recipient and teacher aggregate recipient retain existing visibility, anonymity and release rules; no sensitive individual answers may be disclosed by this metadata.
No research-validation claim, Chinese validated version, norms, ranks, cross-role composite or score inferred.
